utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll swing by the repair drive while I’m out running errands and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. If you can, just let me know what they say and I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll check in and tell you what they say.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the main thing you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a quick check-in on what parts you still need and when you want me to drop by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I still need the wrench set and a replacement hose, and you can drop by tomorrow afternoon if that works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we know for sure the repair drive is still on? I just want to confirm the details before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t know for sure yet, so I’d rather not tell anyone until we confirm the details. Let’s check with the organizer first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That works for me — let’s confirm with the organizer first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need the details again so I don’t mix anything up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — we’re collecting tools, screws, and any spare wood folks can part with. I’ll jot down what you can bring and make sure it gets to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I can bring a small toolbox and a few spare screws from the shed. If I find any usable wood, I’ll add that too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks—maybe just check what tools or supplies we still need first. I’ve been a bit all over the place, so that seems like the best place to start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check what tools and supplies we still need first, and then I’ll let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — what do you need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — thanks for coming by. We’ve got a wobbly front gate and a couple of loose shelves that need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the front gate and those shelves — where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you lend me your socket wrench set and a step ladder for the drive? I’ll make sure they come right back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Gus — you can borrow both. Just bring them back when you’re done, and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is set up, and I can point you there if you want. Do you need the exact location?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please — the exact location would help a lot. I’m trying to plan around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s set up at the community center parking lot on Maple Street, right beside the library entrance. If you’re coming after the school run, the lot usually has the clearest access from Oak Avenue.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still collecting donations and volunteers, and it’s going pretty well so far.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Nice, that’s great to hear — I’ll spread the word and ask a couple more neighbors to chip in or volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we settle where people should drop off the repair items?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I was thinking the community center lot would be easiest. Want me to check with a couple people first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please check with a couple people first. If they’re okay with it, the community center lot sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what they still need. I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate that. I’m still catching up on what they need, so any update helps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll swing by later and ask what they still need, then I’ll pass it along to you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized now, and I’ll keep you posted on the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate you keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’m pulling together the list of repairs and I’ll share the schedule as soon as it’s set.
